name: AWS EKS - Control Plane
description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) allows you to easily deploy, manage, and scale container-based applications with Kubernetes on AWS. The Sumo Logic App for Amazon EKS - Control Plane App provides visibility into the EKS control plane with operational insights into the api server, scheduler, control manager, and worker nodes. The app's preconfigured dashboards display resource-related metrics for Kubernetes deployments, clusters, namespaces, pods, containers, and daemonsets.

children.name: EKS - API Server
children.description: The EKS - API Server dashboard displays information on the API server logs, which is the control plane component that exposes the Kubernetes API. Panels show details on the API server errors, warnings, and activities.
children.title: EKS - API Server

panels.title: API Server Request Latency By Method

queries.queryString: _origin=kubernetes  metric=apiserver_request_latencies_count  cluster={{cluster}}| quantize 5m | rate | sum by verb

panels.title: Api Server Request Rates by  Clients

queries.queryString: _origin=kubernetes  cluster={{cluster}}  (metric=apiserver_request_total or metric=apiserver_request_count) | quantize 5m | rate | sum by client
_origin=kubernetes   cluster={{cluster}} (metric=apiserver_request_total or metric=apiserver_request_count) code=2*  | quantize 5m | rate | sum by cluster

panels.title: API Server Successful vs Failure Request Rates

queries.queryString: _origin=kubernetes   cluster={{cluster}} (metric=apiserver_request_total or metric=apiserver_request_count) !code=2*  | quantize 5m | rate | sum by cluster
_origin=kubernetes   cluster={{cluster}} (metric=apiserver_request_total or metric=apiserver_request_count) code=2*  | quantize 5m | rate | sum by cluster

_sourceCategory = *eks* (error OR warning)
AND _sourceName = kube-api* AND !_sourceName = kube-apiserver-audit*
| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse regex field=log "^^(?<severity>.)(?:[0-9])(?:.*\])\s(?<log_msg>.*)"
| where severity == "E"
| formatDate(_messageTime,"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm") as MessageTime
| count by MessageTime,severity,log_msg

_sourceCategory = *eks* 
AND _sourceName = kube-api* AND !_sourceName = kube-apiserver-audit*
| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse regex field=log "^^(?<severity>.)(?:[0-9])(?:.*\])\s(?<log_msg>.*)"
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, severity
| transpose row _timeslice column severity
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = *eks* 
AND _sourceName = kube-api* AND !_sourceName = kube-apiserver-audit*
| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse regex field=log "^^(?<severity>.)(?:[0-9])(?:.*\])\s(?<log_msg>.*)"

children.name: EKS - API Server Audit
children.description: The EKS - API Server Audit dashboard displays information on Kubernetes audit logs. Panels provide records of individual users, administrators, or system components affected by your cluster.
children.title: EKS - API Server Audit

_sourceCategory = *eks* 
 and _sourceName = kube-apiserver-audit*

| timeslice 1h | count _timeslice, status_code | transpose row _timeslice column status_code

_sourceCategory = *eks*

_sourceCategory = *eks* 
 and _sourceName = kube-apiserver-audit*
| json field=_raw "message.responseStatus.code", "message.verb", "message.requestURI", "message.objectRef.resource", "message.sourceIPs", "message.responseStatus.reason", "message.objectRef.namespace", "message.user.username"   as status_code, method, url, k8_resource, ip, reason, namespace, username
| if (status_code matches "2*", 1,0) as success
| if (status_code matches "4*", 1,0) as failure
| sum(success) as total_succes, sum(failure) as total_failure
| (total_failure/(total_succes + total_failure))*100 as failure_rate
| fields failure_rate

panels.title: Untitled
panels.text:
# Each request can be recorded with an associated “stage”. The known stages are:

* ###RequestReceived - The stage for events generated as soon as the audit handler receives the request, and before it is delegated down the handler chain.

* ###ResponseStarted - Once the response headers are sent, but before the response body is sent. This stage is only generated for long-running requests (e.g. watch).
* ###ResponseComplete - The response body has been completed and no more bytes will be sent.
* ###Panic - Events generated when a panic occurred.

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *eks* 
 and _sourceName = kube-apiserver-audit*
| json field=_raw "message", "message.stage" as log, stage
| count by stage

panels.title: Untitled
panels.text:
# The known audit levels are:

* ###None - don’t log events that match this rule.
* ###Metadata - log request metadata (requesting user, timestamp, resource, verb, etc.) but not request or response body.
* ###Request - log event metadata and request body but not response body. This does not apply for non-resource requests.
* ###RequestResponse - log event metadata, request and response bodies. This does not apply for non-resource requests.

children.name: EKS - Authenticator
children.description: The EKS - Authenticator dashboard displays information on the Authenticator logs which are unique to Amazon EKS. Panels display logs that represent the control plane component Amazon EKS uses for Kubernetes Role Based Access Control (RBAC) authentication using IAM credentials.
children.title: EKS - Authenticator

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *eks* error
 and _sourceName = *authenticator*
| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse field=log "msg=\"*\"" as err_msg
| parse field=log "time=\"*\"" as message_time
| where !(isBlank(message_time)) 
| count by err_msg
| sort by _count
| limit 10

_sourceCategory = *eks* "access granted"
 and _sourceName = *authenticator*
| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse field=log "msg=\"*\"" as err_msg
| parse field=log "username=\"*\"" as username
| count by username
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory = *eks* 
 and _sourceName = *authenticator*
| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse field=log "msg=\"*\"" as message
| parse field=log "username=\"*\"" as username
| parse field=log "time=\"*\"" as message_time
| count by message_time, username, message
| sort by message_time desc

children.name: EKS - Controller Manager
children.description: The EKS - Controller Manager dashboard displays information on the controller manager, providing visibility into the core control loops for Kubernetes.
children.title: EKS - Controller Manager

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = *eks* 
	| json field=_raw "message" as log
	| parse regex field=log "^(?<severity>.)(?:[0-9])"
	| timeslice 1h
	| count _timeslice, severity 
	| transpose row _timeslice column severity
  | fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = *eks* error
| json field=_raw "message"
| parse regex field=message "^(?<severity>.)(?:[0-9])"
| where severity == "E"
| formatDate(_messageTime,"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm") as MessageTime
| count by MessageTime,severity, container, namespace,pod,message

_sourceCategory = *eks* "Created job"
	| json field=_raw "message" as log
	| parse field=log "Created job *" as job
  | parse field=log "* *       " as code,time
  | count by time, job

_sourceCategory = *eks* "Deleted job"
	| json field=_raw "message" as log
  | parse field=log "Deleted job *" as job_name
| count

_sourceCategory = *eks* 
	| json field=_raw "message" as log
| parse regex field=log "^(?<severity>.)(?:[0-9])"
| where severity == "I"
| parse field=log "Scaled * replica set * to *" as direction,replica_set,scaled_to
| first(scaled_to) as scaled_to by  replica_set

_sourceCategory = *eks* "Created pod:"
  | json field=_raw "message" as log
  | parse field=log "Created pod: *" as pod
  | parse field=log "* *       " as code,time
  | count by time, pod

_sourceCategory = *eks* "Deleted pod:"
	| json field=_raw "message" as log
	| parse field=log "Deleted pod: *" as pod
  | parse field=log "* *       " as code,time
  | count by time, pod
